verses: Aey nabi! Allah Taalaa say dartay rehna aur kafiron aur munafiqon ki baaton mein na aajana, Allah Taalaa baray ilm wala aur bari hikmat wala hai
Jo kuch aap ki janib aap kay rab ki taraf say wahee ki jati hai uss ki tabeydaari keren (yaqeen mano) kay Allah tumharay her aik amal say ba-khabar hai
Aap Allah hi per tawakkal rakhen, woh kaar saazi kay liye kafi hai

Kissi aadmi kay seenay mein Allah Taalaa ney do dil nahi rakhay, aur apni jin biwiyon ko tum maa keh bethtay ho unhen Allah ney tumhari (sach much ki) maayen nahi banaya, aur na tumharay ley paalak larkon ko (waqaee) tumharay betay banaya hai, yeh to tumharay apney mun ki baaten hain, Allah Taalaa haq baat farmata hai aur woh (seedhi) raah sujhata hai

Ley palakon ko unn kay (haqeeqi) baapon ki taraf nisbat ker kay bulao Allah kay nazdeek poora insaf yehi hai. Phir agar tumhen unn kay (haqeeqi) baapon ka ilm hi na ho to woh tumharay deeni bhai aur dost hain, tum say bhool chook mein jo kuch ho jaye uss mein tum per koi gunah nahi, albatta gunah woh hai jiss ka tum iradah dil say kero. Allah Taalaa bara hi bakhshney wala meharban hai

Payghumbar mominon per khud unn say bhi ziyadah haq rakhney walay hain aur payghumbar ki biwiyan mominon ki maayen hain, aur rishtay daar kitab Allah ki roo say ba nisbat doosray mominon aur mohajiron kay aapas mein ziyadah haq daar hain (haan) magar yeh kay tum apney doston kay sath husn-o-khoobi salook kerna chahao. Yeh hukum kitab (elahi) mein likha hua hai
Jab kay hum ney tamam nabiyon say ehad liya aur (bilkhusoos) aap say aur Nooh say aur Ibrahim say aur Musa say aur Maryam kay betay Isa say, aur hum ney unn say (pakka aur) pukhta ehad liya
Takay Allah Taalaa sachon say unn ki sachaee kay baray mein daryaft farmaye, aur kafiron kay liye hum ney alamnaak azab tayyar ker rakhay hain

Aey eman walo! Allah Taalaa ney jo ehsan tum per kiya ussay yaad kero jabkay tumharay muqablay ko fojon per fojen aayen phir hum ney unn per tez tund aandhi aur aisay lashkar bhejay jinhen tum ney dekha hi nahi, aur jo kuch tum kertay ho Allah Taalaa sab kuch dekhta hai
Jab kay (dushman) tumharay pass upper say aur neechay say charh aaye aur jab kay aankhen pathra gaeen aur kalejay mun ko aagaye aur tum Allah Taalaa ki nisbat tarah tarah kay guman kerney lagay
Yahin momin aazmaye gaye aur poori tarah woh jhanjhor diye gaye
Aur uss waqt munafiq aur woh log jin kay dilon mein (shak ka) rog tha kehney lagay Allah Taalaa aur uss kay rasool ney hum say mehaz dhoka fareb ka hi wada kiya tha

Unn hi ki aik jamat ney haank lagaee kay aey madina walo! tumharay liye thikana nahi chalo lot chalo, aur unn ki aik aur jamat yeh keh ker nabi) salla Allah alaihi wasallam (say ijazat mangney lagi kay humaray ghar ghair mehfooz hain, halankay woh (khulay huye aur) ghair mehfooz na thay (lekin) unn ka pukhta iradah bhaag kharay honey ka tha
Aur agar madinay kay aitraaf say unn per (lashkar) dakhil kiye jatay phir unn say fitna talab kiya jata to yeh zaroor ussay barpa ker detay aur na lartay magar thori muddat
Uss say pehlay to unhon ney Allah say ehad kiya tha kay peeth na pheren gay, aur Allah Taalaa say kiye huye wada ki baaz purs zaroor hogi
Keh dijiye kay go tum maut say ya khof qatal say bhago to yeh bhagna tumhen kuch bhi kaam na aaye ga aur uss waqt tum boht hi kum faeedah uthao gay

Poochiye! to kay agar Allah Taalaa tumhen koi buraee phonchana chahaye ya tum per koi fazal kerna chahaye to kaun hai jo tumhen bacha sakay (ya tum say rok sakay?), apney liye ba-juz Allah Taalaa kay na koi himayati payen gay na madadgar
Allah Taalaa tum mein say unhen (bakhoobi) janta hai jo doosron ko roktay hain aur apney bhai bandon say kehtay hain kay humaray pass chalay aao. Aur kabhi kabhi hi laraee mein aajatay hain

Tumhari madad mein (pooray) bakheel hain, phir jab khof o dehshat ka moqa aajaye to aap unhen dekhen gay kay aap ki taraf nazren jama detay hain aur unn ki aankhen uss tarah ghoomti hain jaisay uss shakhs ki jiss per maut ki ghashi taari ho. Phir jab khof jata rehta hai to tum per apni tez zabano say bari baaten banatay hain maal kay baray hi harees hain, yeh eman laye hi nahi hain Allah Taalaa ney unn kay tamam aemaal nabood ker diye hain, aur Allah Taalaa per yeh boht hi aasan hai

Samajhtay hain kay abb tak lashkar chalay nahi gaye, aur agar fojen aajayen to tamannayen kertay hain kay kaash! woh sehra mein badiya nasheenon kay sath hotay kay tumhari khabren daryaft kiya kertay, agar woh tum mein mojood hotay (to bhi kiya?) na lartay magar baraye naam
Yaqeenan tumharay liye rasool Allah mein umdah namoona (mojood) hai, her uss shakhs kay liye jo Allah Taalaa ki aur qayamat kay din ki tawaqqa rakhta hai aur ba-kasrat Allah Taalaa ki yaad kerta hai

Aur eman walon ney jab (kuffaar kay) lashkaron ko dekha (bey saakhita) keh uthay! kay unhen ka wada humen Allah Taalaa ney aur uss kay rasool ney diya tha aur Allah Taalaa aur uss kay rasool ney sach farmaya, aur uss (cheez) ney unn kay eman mein aur sheewa farman bardari mein aur izafa ker diya

Mominon mein (aisay) log bhi hain jinhon ney jo ehad Allah Taalaa say kiya tha unhen sacha ker dikhaya, baaz ney to apna ehad poora ker diya aur baaz (moqa kay) muntazir hain aur unhon ney koi tabdeeli nahi ki
Takay Allah Taalaa sachon ko unn ki sachaee ka badla dey aur agar chahaye to munafiqon ko saza dey ya unn ki tauba qabool farmaye, Allah Taalaa bara hi bakhshney wala boht hi meharban hai

Aur Allah Taalaa kafiron ko ghussay bharay huye hi (murad) lota diya unhon ney koi faeedah nahi paya, aur uss jang mein Allah Taalaa khud hi mominon ko kafi hogaya Allah Taalaa bari qooaton wala aur ghalib hai

Aur jin ahl kitab ney unn say saaz baaz ker li thi unhen (bhi) Allah Taalaa ney unn kay qilon say nikal diya aur unn kay dilon mein (bhi) rob bhar diya kay tum unn kay aik giroh ko qatal ker rahey ho aur aik giroh ko qaidi bana rahey ho
Aur uss ney tumhen unn ki zaminon ka aur unn kay ghar baar ka aur unn kay maal ka waris ker diya aur uss zamin ka bhi jiss ko tumharay qadmon ney ronda nahi, Allah Taalaa her cheez per qadir hai
Aey nabi! apni biwiyon say keh do kay agar tum zindagani duniya aur zeenat duniya chahati ho to aao mein tumhen kuch dey dila doon aur tumhen achai kay sath rukhsat ker doon
Aur agar tumhari murad Allah aur uss ka rasool aur aakhirat ka ghar hai to (yaqeen mano kay) tum mein say nek kaam kerney waliyon kay liye Allah Taalaa ney boht zabardast ajar rakh choray hain
Aey nabi ki biwiyo! tum mein say jo bhi khulli bey hayaee (ka irtakaab) keray gi ussay dohra dohra azab diya jaye ga, aur Allah Taalaa kay nazdeek yeh boht hi sehal (si baat) hai
Aur tum mein say jo koi Allah ki aur uss kay rasool ki farmanbardari keray gi aur nek kaam keray gi hum ussay ajar (bhi) dohra den gay aur uss kay liye hum ney behtareen rozi tayyar ker rakhi hai

Aey nabi ki biwiyo! tum aam aurton ki tarah nahi ho, agar tum perhezgari ikhtiyar kero to naram lehjay say baat na kero kay jiss kay dil mein rog ho woh koi bura khayal keray aur haan qaeeday kay mutabiq kalaam kero

Aur apney gharon mein qarar say raho aur qadeem jaheeliyat kay zamaney ki tarah apney banao ka izhar na kero aur namaz ada kerti raho aur zakat deti raho aur Allah aur uss kay rasool ki ita’at guzari kero. Allah Taalaa yehi chahata hai kay aey nabi ki ghar wali o! tum say woh (her qasam ki) gandagi ko door kerdey aur tumhen khoob pak kerdey
Aur tumharay gharon mein Allah ki jo aayaten aur rasool ki aahdees parhi jati hain unn ka zikar kerti raho, yaqeenan Allah Taalaa lutf kerney wala khabardaar hai

Be-shak musalman mard aur musalman aurten momin mard aur momin aurten farman bardari kerney walay mard aur farmanbardar aurten raast baaz mard aur raast baaz aurten sabar kerney walay mard aur sabar kerney wali aurten, aajzi kerney walay mard aur aajzi kerney wali aurten, kheyraat kerney walay mard aur kheyraat kerney wali aurten, rozay rakhney walay mard aur rozay rakhney wali aurten apni sharamgah ki hifazat kerney walay mard aur hifazat kerney waliyan ba-kasrat Allah ka zikar kerney walay aur zikar kerney waliyan unn (sab kay) liye Allah Taalaa ney (wasee) maghfirat aur bara sawab tayyar ker rakha hai

Aur (dekho) kissi momin mard o aurat ko Allah aur uss kay rasool ka faisla kay baad apney kissi amar ka koi ikhtiyar baqi nahi rehta, (yaad rakho) Allah Taalaa aur uss kay rasool ki jo bhi na-farmani keray ga woh sareeh gumrahi mein paray ga

(yaad kero) jab kay to uss shakhs say keh raha tha jiss per Allah ney bhi inam kiya aur tu ney bhi kay to apni biwi ko apney pass rakh aur Allah say darr aur to apney dil mein woh baat chupaye huye tha jissay Allah zahir kerney wala tha aur to logon say khof khata tha, halankay Allah Taalaa uss ka ziyadah haq daar tha kay to uss say daray, pus jab kay zaid ney uss aurat say apni gharz poori kerli hum ney ussay teray nikkah mein dey diya takay musalmanon per apney ley palakon ki biwiyon kay baray mein kissi tarah ki tangi na rahey jab kay woh apni gharz unn say poori kerlen, Allah ka (yeh) hukum to ho ker hi rehney wala tha

Jo cheezen Allah Taalaa ney apney nabi kay liye muqarrar ki hain unn mein nabi per koi haraj nahi, (yehi) Allah ka dastoor unn mein bhi raha jo pehlay huye aur Allah Taalaa kay kaam andazay per muqarrar kiye huye hain
Yeh sab aisay thay kay Allah Taalaa kay ehkaam phonchaya kertay thay aur Allah hi say dartay thay aur Allah kay siwa kissi say nahi dartay thay, aur Allah Taalaa hisab lenay kay liye kafi hai

(logo) tumharay mardon mein say kissi kay baap Muhammad) salla Allah alaihi wasallam (nahi lekin aap Allah Taalaa kay rasool hain aur tamam nabiyon kay khatam kerney walay, aur Allah Taalaa her cheez ka (bakhoobi) jannay wala hai
Musalmano! Allah Taalaa ka zikar boht ziyadah kero
Aur subha o shaam uss ki pakeezgi biyan kero

O hi hai jo tum per apni rehmaten bhejta hai aur uss kay farishtay (tumharay liye duaa-e rehmat kertay hain) takay woh tumhen andheron say ujalay ki taraf ley jaye aur Allah Taalaa mominon per boht hi meharban hai
Jiss din yeh (Allah say) mulaqat keren gay unn ka tohfa salam hoga, unn kay liye Allah Taalaa ney ba-izzat ajar tayyar ker rakha hai
Aey nabi! yaqeenan hum ney hi aap ko (rasool bana ker) gawahiyan denay wala, khushkhabriyan sunaney wala, aagah kerney wala bheja hai
Aur Allah kay hukum say uss ki taraf bulanay wala aur roshan chiragh
Aap mominon ko khushkhabri suna dijiye! kay unn kay liye Allah ki taraf say boht bara fazal hai
Aur kafiron aur munafiqon ka kehna na maniyey! aur jo ezza (unn ki taraf say phonchay) uss ka khayal bhi na kijiye Allah per bharosa kiye rahen, aur kafi hai Allah Taalaa kaam bananey wala

Aey momin! jab tum momin aurton say nikkah kero phir hath laganey say pehlay (hi) tallaq dey do to unn per tumhara koi haq iddat ka nahi jissay tum shumar kero, pus tum kuch na kuch unhen dey do aur bhalay tareeq per unhen rukhsat ker do

Aey nabi! hum ney teray liye teri woh biwiyan halal ker di hain jinhon to unn ka mehar dey chuka hai aur woh londiyan bhi jo Allah Taalaa ney ghanimat mein tujhay di hain aur teray chacha ki larkiyan aur phoophiyon ki betiyan aur teray mamoon ki betiyan aur teri khalaon ki betiyan bhi jinhon ney teray sath hijrat ki hai, aur woh ba-emaan aurat jo apna nafs nabi ko hiba kerdey yeh uss soorat mein kay khud nabi bhi uss say nikkah kerna chahaye, yeh khaas tor per sirf teray liye hi hai aur mominon kay liye nahi, hum ussay bakhoobi jantay hain jo hum ney unn per unn ki biwiyon aur londiyon kay baray mein (ehkaam) muqarrar ker rakhay hain, yeh uss liye kay tujh per haraj waqey na ho, Allah Taalaa boht bakhshney aur baray reham wala hai

Unn mein say jissay to chahaye door rakh dey aur jissay chahaye apney pass rakh ley, aur agar tu ney unn mein say bhi kissi ko apney pass bula jinhen tu ney alag ker rakha tha to tujh per koi gunah nahi, uss mein uss baat ki ziyadah tawaqqa hai kay unn aurton ki aankhen thandi rahen aur woh ranjeedah na hun aur jo kuch bhi to unhen dey dey uss per sab ki sab razi rahen. Tumharay dilon mein jo kuch hai ussay Allah (khoob) janta hai. Allah Taalaa bara hi ilm aur hilm wala hai

Uss kay baad aur aurten aap kay liye halal nahi aur na yeh (durust hai) kay unn kay badlay aur aurton say (nikkah keray) agar cheh unn ki soorat achi bhi lagti ho magar jo teri mamlooka hun. Aur Allah Taalaa her cheez ka (poora) nigehbaan hai

Aey eman walo! jab tak tumhen ijazat na di jaye tum nabi kay gharon mein na jaya kero khaney kay liye aisay waqt mein kay uss kay pakney ka intizar kertay raho balkay)yeh jab bulaya jaye jao aur jab kha chuko nikal kharay ho, o hain baaton mein mashghool na hojaya kero. Nabi ko tumhari uss baat say takleef hoti hai. To woh lehaz ker jatay hain aur Allah Taalaa (biyan) haq mein kissi ka lehaz nahi kerta, jab tum nabi ki biwiyon say koi cheez talab kero to parday kay peechay say talab kero. Tumharay aur unn kay dilon kay liye kamil pakeezgi yehi hai, na tumhen yeh jaeez hai kay tum rasool Allah ko takleef do aur na tumhen yeh halal hai kay aap kay baad kissi waqt bhi aap ki biwiyon say nikkah kero. (yaad rakho) Allah kay nazdeek yeh boht bara (gunah) hai
Tum kissi cheez ko zahir kero ya makhfi rakho Allah to her her cheez ka bakhoobi ilm rakhney wala hai

Unn aurton per koi gunah nahi kay woh apney baapon aur apney beton aur bhaiyon aur bhatijon aur bhanjon aur apni (mail jol ki) aurton aur milkiyat kay matehaton (londi, ghulam) kay samney hun. (aurto!) Allah say darti raho. Allah Taalaa yaqeenan her cheez per shahid hai
Allah Taalaa aur uss kay farishtay uss nabi per rehmat bhejtay hain. Aey eman walo! tum (bhi) unn per durood bhejo aur khoob salam (bhi) bhejtay raha kero
Jo log Allah aur uss kay rasool ko ezza detay hain unn per duniya aur aakhirat mein Allah ki phitkaar hai aur unn kay liye nihayat ruswa kun azab hai
Aur jo log momin mardon aur momin aurton ko ezza den baghair kissi jurum kay jo unn say sirzad hua ho, woh (baray hi) bohtan aur sareeh gunah ka bojh uthatay hain

Aey nabi! apni biwiyon say aur apni shabzadiyon say aur musalmanon ki aurten say keh do kay woh apney upper apni chadaren latka liya keren, uss say boht jald unn ki shanakht ho jaya keray gi phir na sataee jayen gi, aur Allah Taalaa bakhshney wala meharban hai

Agar (abb bhi) yeh munafiq aur woh jin kay dilon mein beemari hai aur woh log jo madina mein ghalat afwahen uraney walay hain baaz na aaye to hum aap ko unn (ki tabahi) per musallat ker den gay phir to woh chand din hi aap kay sath uss (shehar) mein reh saken gay
Unn per phitkaar barsaee gaee, jahan bhi mill jayen pakray jayen aur khoob tukray tukray kerdiye jayen
Unn say aglon mein bhi Allah ka yehi dastoor jari raha. Aur to Allah kay dastoor mein hergiz radd-o-badal na paye ga
Log aap say qayamat kay baray mein sawal kertay hain. Aap keh dijiye! kay uss ka ilm to Allah hi ko hai, aap ko kiya khabar boht mumkin hai qayamat bilkul hi qareeb ho
Allah Taalaa ney kafiron per laanat ki hai aur unn kay liye bharakti hui aag tayyar ker rakhi hai
Jiss mein woh hamesha hamesha rahen gay. Woh koi haami o madadgar na payen gay
Uss din unn kay chehray aag mein ulat palat kiye jayen gay. (hasrat o afsos say) kahen gay kay kaash hum Allah Taalaa aur rasool ki ita’at kertay
Aur kahen gay aey humaray rab! hum ney apney sardaron aur apney baron ki mani jinhon ney humen raah raast say bhatka diya
Perwerdigar to unhen dugna azab dey aur unn per boht bari laanat nazil farma
Aey eman walo! unn logon jaisay na bann jao jinhon ney Musa ko takleef di pus jo baat unhon ney kahi thi Allah ney unhen uss say buri farma diya, aur woh Allah kay nazdeek ba-izzat thay
Aey eman walo! Allah Taalaa say daro aur seedhi seedhi (sachi) baaten kiya kero
Takay Allah Taalaa tumharay kaam sanwaar dey aur tumharay gunah moaf farma dey, aur jo bhi Allah aur uss kay rasool ki tabeydaari keray ga uss ney bari murad paali

Hum ney apni amanat ko aasmano per zamin per aur paharon per paish kiya lekin sab ney uss kay uthaney say inkar kerdiya aur uss say darr gaye (magar) insan ney ussay utha liya, woh bara hi zalim jahil hai
(yeh uss liye) kay Allah Taalaa munafiq mardon aurton aur mushrik mardon aurton ko saza dey aur momin mardon aurton ki tauba qabool farmaye, aur Allah Taalaa bara hi bakhshney wala aur meharban hai
